sloka: आर्तस्वरम् तु तम् भर्तुः विज्ञाय सदृशम् वने ।उवाच लक्ष्मणम् सीता गच्छ जानीहि राघवम् ॥३-४५-१॥
transliteration: ārtasvaram tu tam bhartuḥ vijñāya sadṛśam vane ।uvāca lakṣmaṇam sītā gaccha jānīhi rāghavam ॥3-45-1॥

translations.english: On hearing the voice in distress and recognising that it was similar to her husband's voice, Sita said to Lakshmana, 'Go and find out Rama's whereabouts'.
